field.name: Options
field.summary: Serializer options used by the utility.

method.name: IsSupportedType
method.summary: Determine whether a runtime type is supported by the source-generated JSON context.
method.returns: True when the type is available from the source-generated JSON context; otherwise false.

method.name: IsSupportedGeneric
method.summary: Determine whether a generic type is supported by the source-generated JSON context.
method.returns: True when the type is available from the source-generated JSON context; otherwise false.

method.name: Serialize
method.summary: Serialize a value to UTF-8 JSON bytes.

method.name: SerializeType
method.summary: Serialize a value to UTF-8 JSON bytes using an explicit runtime type.

method.name: Deserialize
method.summary: Deserialize a value from UTF-8 JSON bytes.

method.name: DeserializeMemory
method.summary: Deserialize a value from UTF-8 JSON bytes.

method.name: DeserializeType
method.summary: Deserialize a value from UTF-8 JSON bytes using an explicit runtime type.

method.name: DeserializeMemoryType
method.summary: Deserialize a value from UTF-8 JSON bytes using an explicit runtime type.

method.name: Parse
method.summary: Deserialize a value from a JSON string.

method.name: ParseType
method.summary: Deserialize a value from a JSON string using an explicit runtime type.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Serialize a value to a JSON string.

method.name: ToStringType
method.summary: Serialize a value to a JSON string using an explicit runtime type.

method.name: WriteIndented
method.summary: Serialize a value to an indented JSON string using an explicit runtime type.

method.name: TryParse
method.summary: Try to deserialize a value from a JSON string.

method.name: TryParseType
method.summary: Try to deserialize a value from a JSON string using an explicit runtime type.

method.name: ToFile
method.summary: Serialize a value to a file as UTF-8 JSON bytes.
method.returns: True if the file was written successfully.

method.name: ToFileType
method.summary: Serialize a value to a file as UTF-8 JSON bytes using an explicit runtime type.
method.returns: True if the file was written successfully.

method.name: FromFile
method.summary: Deserialize a value from a UTF-8 JSON file.

method.name: FromFileType
method.summary: Deserialize a value from a UTF-8 JSON file using an explicit runtime type.
